plan.title: Select Existing Direct-Bid Event for Counter Offer

steps.note: Open the Events list where the Live, History, Drafts, and Recurring tabs are available.
Verify the Events list rendered successfully before selecting an event.
Restrict the candidates to live events, including events currently in evaluation.
Open the first live event whose card indicates it is in evaluation.
Confirm the selected event is in the required evaluation state.
Verify that the buyer sees exactly one direct vendor response and therefore the bid was placed by the vendor rather than added as a surrogate bid.
